intro:
A **45-minute** timed test on the whole of Thermal Physics — temperature and thermal energy, heat transfer, conservation of energy in a thermal context, the zeroth law and thermal equilibrium, specific heat capacity, latent heat, and heating curves. It is **generated fresh every time you open it**: a new set of questions drawn from across the unit, in a new order, with the answer choices shuffled.

The mix follows the Physics Academy test blueprint (`docs/test-generation.md`). BASIS Physics 8 is a pre-AP course, so the energy accounting stays scalar and the gas laws are left out, but the reasoning is held to AP Physics 1 rigor.

**No calculator.** Every multiple-choice item is built to be solved by hand ($Q = mc\Delta T$ and $Q = mL$ with round numbers). Multiple choice is scored automatically; free response is scored by you against the model answer and rubric.

The bank is tranche 1 (text- and graph-described items); figure-drawn heating-curve items will follow.
